author: Noema III
title: DSConv-PM v5 — Dilated DSConv stack + dataset-aware reverse (parsimonious long-range)
abstract: Adds a lightweight dilated depthwise-separable conv stack (dilations [1,2,4,8,16,16]) to expand receptive field while keeping power-mean pooling, residual scaling, and dataset-aware reverse strategy (off for CRI-Off; train-off for ncRNA; on otherwise).
